people.imagined: At dusk in the furnace yard, the glow turning the hills purple. He has just tasted a pill from a spoon and is thinking; the lips are stained from seventy years of this.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk beside a squat clay furnace, he has just tasted a dab from a small spoon and stands thoughtful, looking at the viewer. Face: a lean, calm, long face; tanned skin; deep-set patient brown eyes; calm level brows; a long straight nose; his lips and the corners of his mouth stained a faint but plain purple, clearly visible; fine lines at the mouth. A long straight nose and wide-set patient eyes; the purple stain extends in a thin line along the lower lip and into the corners of the mouth. Hair: black with a little grey, in a plain topknot with a wooden pin. The wooden pin is plain, and a thin strand of grey crosses the forehead. Body: lean, relaxed, unhurried, shoulders loose. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back by two cords; a pale violet inner collar; a herb pouch at the hip. The pale violet inner collar is soft and slightly faded, and the cords that tie his sleeves are brown linen; the herb pouch at his hip is stitched with a leaf pattern. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a small spoon at lip height; his left hand rests on the shoulder-high squat clay censer-furnace, its coals glowing a deep orange at the vent. Background: blurred wood of mulberry trees, a lilac-purple hill under a glowing sunset. Light: warm orange-gold evening light from the upper left, the furnace glow on his hand. Qi: a faint green-gold haze at the furnace vent. Expression: patient, devout, mildly thoughtful. He shows no hurry and a slight absent look, as if still listening to the taste on his tongue.

people.imagined: Evening on the steppe, beside a cold bronze furnace and a grave. He polishes the furnace with a cloth until the light goes. He does not look up at first.
people.subject: The moment: seated at dusk on the steppe beside a cold bronze furnace, he polishes its side with a folded cloth and slowly lifts his eyes to the viewer. It is the evening of one more day on which he has not lit the furnace; Nhạc Viễn Chí has just lit his lamp behind him. Face: a long, gaunt, noble old face; deep creases; heavy-lidded calm grey-brown eyes; thin white brows; a long nose; thin mouth in a quiet line; sunken cheeks; faint age spots. Hair: long white hair tied back low, a thin white beard to the collarbone. The beard is soft as cotton and the hair, held by a bone comb, shines silver in the sunset. Body: tall, spare, stooped by years. His long fingers are thin and spotted, and the shoulders under the robe are narrow but upright. Clothing: an earth-brown robe, well made and clean but stained at the knees with brown soil from years of kneeling; the sleeves tied back with cords; on the collar a single green perilla leaf pinned, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand rubs a cloth over the bronze body of a cold, round-bellied bronze furnace with a lid; the polished metal reflects the red sunset; on his left hand a ring of pale bone set with a small brown camellia seed. Background: a flat brown steppe with grass, one low mound with a young shoot growing on it, and a deep orange sunset. Light: low orange light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale gold-green dusk glimmer. Expression: calm, grieving, withdrawn. His eyes rest on the viewer without surprise, as though he has been expecting someone for a very long time.

people.imagined: Kneeling in the grass at sunset on the Dusk Field. A seed-head in hand, picking, hoping not to be asked a single question.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in wild grass at sunset with a stem of purple-grey herb in her fingers, she looks up at the viewer with a trace of weariness, her basket picked and the hour nearly over, hoping not to be asked a single question. Face: a brown, wiry, sun-hard face with high cheekbones, narrow dark eyes with crow's-feet, straight thin brows, a thin nose and a firm mouth. Hair: black with a few grey threads, in a low knot with grass seeds, dry seed-heads, bits of dry stalk and a small white moth caught all through it, clearly visible. Body: wiry and tough, bent at the knees with corded brown forearms and the knees pressed into the soil. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back and leather knee guards sewn on for kneeling, a straw cape on her shoulders, and a lacquered bottle gourd hanging at her hip on a cord. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a stem of grey-green herb with a tiny purple flower; the left holds the glossy brown gourd. Background: a wide steppe of golden grass, low purple hills and an orange sunset. Light: warm low light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer around the herb. Expression: a flat, polite, tired gaze with a slight tightening around the mouth, stubborn and patient, a woman fending off a conversation by saying nothing.

people.imagined: At the furnace house, patting his round belly as he thinks, hands black with charcoal. He is holding a bag of lots behind his back.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a furnace, he pats his round belly with a charcoal-black hand while thinking, a sly look in his eyes, and a small cloth bag of lots held behind his back with short sticks sewn into its lining. Face: a round, plump, sooty face with wide cheeks, a dimple in the round chin, small shrewd dark eyes ringed with soot, thick black brows, a flat nose, a genial smile and a smear of soot on one cheek. Hair: black, in a short topknot tied with a strip of cloth and powdered grey with ash. Body: stout and round-bellied with thick arms, standing easy. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back, a sturdy leather apron over it and leather knee guards sewn on for the furnace house. Hands and objects: every knuckle of both hands is black with charcoal, plainly visible; one hand pats the belly, the other, hidden behind him, holds the small cloth bag. Background: the blurred red-orange glow of a furnace mouth and stacked pale mulberry logs, a young disciple only hinted at waiting by the bank. Light: orange furnace light from below and the left, rimming the belly and the ash in his hair. Qi: a faint warm red-orange glow. Expression: a genial, scheming smile just a little too wide, the small dark eyes cheerful and unreadable, a man who is certain he is the cleverest person in the room.

people.imagined: In the mulberry wood at a trade meeting. She gives a clipped smile while her thumb feels a price list sewn in her sleeve. She is eyeing a buyer's guild seat.
people.subject: The moment: standing among mulberry trees, she gives a brief, narrow-eyed smile at the viewer while her thumb presses at the inside of her sleeve. A buyer from the Thúy Vi guild has walked in with his hands behind his back, and she has begun to name a price. Face: a sharp, narrow, pretty face with a pointed chin; fair skin; sharp dark eyes with an appraising glance; thin high-arched brows; a thin straight nose; red-painted narrow lips in a tight smile. Hair: black, in a tall glossy coil held by two jade-green pins. Her hair is oiled to a mirror shine and not one strand is out of place. Body: slim, upright, poised. She stands very straight, her chin slightly raised, hip against a tree. Clothing: a robe of fine silk dyed the green of mulberry leaves, with a smoke-grey inner robe and a smoke-grey sash; sleeves loose and long; at the inner cuff a visible seam where a price list is sewn. Hands and objects: her left hand holds a small sprig of green mistletoe with white berries; her right thumb rubs the sewn cuff. Background: blurred mulberry trunks with clumps of green mistletoe high in the branches, green dappled light. Light: dappled green-gold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale green shimmer at the mistletoe. Expression: shrewd, cold-friendly, hungry. A smile with a thin edge; her eyes tally the visitor's coat, ring and shoes.

people.imagined: On the ash sacks by the bellows at night, a licorice twig in the corner of his mouth, caught half asleep and trying to look busy.
people.subject: The moment: slumped against an ash sack by the bellows at night, a licorice twig between his teeth, he blinks and tries to look hardworking, caught half asleep. Face: a broad, soft face with a wide jaw, faint stubble, sleepy half-lidded brown eyes, thick brows, a lazy smile around the twig and a smudge of ash on the nose. Hair: black, messy, flat on one side, with grey ash in it. Body: broad log-driver's shoulders gone soft, long and loose, tilted against the sacks with one hand trailing. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth creased from sleeping, the left sleeve come untied and dragging in the ash, a sprig of licorice stem at the collar and a herb pouch at the hip hanging open to show a bit of dried root. Hands and objects: one hand grips the bellows handle half-heartedly; the other holds the twig. Background: blurred orange furnace glow, ash sacks stacked high, a dark roof, the head's own furnace glowing behind him banked by someone else, and a pale line of dawn at a high window. Light: warm orange furnace light from the lower left with a cool blue edge from the window. Qi: a faint warm green haze. Expression: a sleepy, sly, easygoing half-smile, the eyes at half mast and the twig riding up at one corner of the mouth, an easy man who would rather be forgiven than ever hurried.

people.imagined: At the courtyard gate, preparing for the long walk north with a tincture flask that she was told to leave. She holds both wrists up and counts her bracelets.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a courtyard gate with a travelling bundle and showing both wrists to the viewer, each wrapped in woven grass bracelets, she looks earnestly out; the head told her to stay home this year, she has packed anyway, and the road north is three months each way. Face: a small, kind, round face with brown skin, wide honest dark eyes, soft brows, a short nose, a faint blush and a gentle, brave smile. Hair: black, in two low braids tied with fresh green grass blades, a few stray hairs blown across her cheek. Body: small, sturdy and ready to travel, feet planted. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back, leather knee guards sewn on for the road, a straw cape slung on her back and a herb pouch at the hip. Hands and objects: both wrists carry pale woven-grass bracelets, five on the left and four on the right, clearly visible; her hands hold a small stoppered flask of amber liquid. Background: a blurred wooden gate and a road of pale dust disappearing north. Light: warm morning light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green shimmer at the flask. Expression: a worried courage, the mouth soft and the brows lifted, the earnest look of a girl who has decided to disobey politely and is not yet sure it will be forgiven.

people.imagined: Alone on the Dusk Field, humming a tune her grandmother said never to play at dusk, a reed flute in her braid. She stops, startled, when she sees she is not alone.
people.subject: The moment: in a field at dusk she stops humming mid-note and looks round, wide-eyed and startled at the viewer with lips still pursed; the tune her grandmother forbade has slipped out and she has been caught by her own voice. Face: a small, round, shy face with pale brown skin, large dark eyes, fine brows, a button nose, faint dimples and pursed lips. Hair: black, in a long single braid with a short reed flute pushed through the top of it, clearly visible. Body: slight, small and narrow, with short brown fingers. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back and leather knee guards sewn on, dew darkening the grey at the knees, and a straw cape bound with a plait of dry reed. Hands and objects: both hands hold a bundle of cut grey-green herbs against her chest. Background: a blurred golden dusk field running toward a purple hill, one distant picker's cape a dot against the grass, the picker's baskets standing empty. Light: low warm gold-orange light from the upper left with a cool lilac shadow behind. Qi: a faint pale gold-green shimmer. Expression: startled, shy and innocent, her cheeks colouring and the mouth still a little round from the last note, the guilty look of a child who did not mean to be heard.

people.imagined: Walking a cart rail like a rope in the wood, arms out for balance, grinning with a missing tooth, a bundle of mistletoe cuttings tucked under one arm.
people.subject: The moment: walking a single cart rail like a rope, he grins broadly at the viewer, one upper eyetooth missing in the grin and clearly visible, carrying cuttings for the rope-walk's smaller orphans. Face: a thin, freckled, cheeky face with sharp cheekbones, bright brown eyes, untidy brows, a wide gap-toothed grin and a scab on the chin. Hair: brown and spiky, with a wisp of straw and a crane's wing feather tucked behind one ear. Body: skinny, nimble and loose, his bare feet gripping the iron rail with the toes, the balance looking effortless. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth, shortened and hitched up with a rope, leather knee guards scuffed pale from climbing, a straw cape slung back and a herb pouch bulging with cuttings; a few green mistletoe berries are crushed on one sleeve. Hands and objects: palms open to the air for balance, the green bundle clamped against his ribs. Background: a line of mulberry trunks behind him and a cart half hidden in the leaves. Light: dappled green-gold light from the upper left across his face and the rail. Qi: none. Expression: a cheeky, reckless grin that fades for a moment into something like pride, the eyes bright and generous, a boy giving away what is not his and enjoying it.

people.imagined: Someone has just said a kind word and she tilts her head as if checking it for a flaw. Her sandals are gone down the stream; her feet are bare.
people.subject: The moment: tilting her head far to one side, she looks at the viewer with suspicion and hope, as if checking a kind word for a flaw; someone has just said she did well, the sprout in her pot is the third she has planted, and the stream has already taken her sandals. Face: a thin, serious, young face with pale skin, large dark careful eyes, raised and slightly knitted brows and a small closed mouth with a doubtful curve. Hair: black, in a neat low bun, a wet strand clinging to her forehead and a small leaf stuck behind her ear. Body: slim and small, the shoulders slightly raised as though braced against the next misfortune. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back and a straw cape over it, the hem wet and muddy, and she is barefoot, the bare feet in mud visible at the bottom edge. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small seedling pot with a drooping grey-green dusk-wormwood sprout. Background: a blurred wet field, a stream and grey drizzle. Light: dim grey light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green shimmer on the sprout. Expression: a cautious, searching hope, the head tilted and the dark eyes combing the kind words for the catch, the half-smile of a girl who has been unlucky long enough to doubt good news.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at dusk, in the hour of the glow she picked in, holding a newborn's cloth.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened; a woman stands at dusk with herbs in one hand and her other arm cradling a folded cloth, on the evening in 1080 when she found a baby at the gate in the hour of the glow. Face: an oval, calm, intelligent face with olive skin, steady dark eyes, fine straight brows, a gentle firm mouth and a faint line between the brows. Hair: black, in a smooth low coil with a single green perilla-leaf pin at the back, bright against the black. Body: slender and upright, her stance slightly forward and protective of the bundle on her arm. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of fine cloth with the sleeves tied back with cords, a pale violet inner collar, a straw cape and a herb pouch. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a stem of purple-flowered herb; the left arm holds a small folded pale bundle of cloth against her side. Background: a purple evening hill with a band of orange glow along the horizon. Light: warm low glow from the upper left, fading to old-silk yellow at the edges. Qi: a faint pale green-gold haze. Expression: a serene, grave tenderness mixed with the quiet ambition that built the pavilion, the eyes steady and the mouth softly closed, a woman who has already decided to keep the child and to found a house.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the picker as he saved the last wormwood bed from a grass fire, a bundle of seedlings held against his chest.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened; a stubborn, brave man clutches a bundle of seedlings to his chest with his face lit by an orange glow from the side, having dug up as many wormwood plants as he can carry before the grass fire reaches the last bed. Face: a square, weathered, lined face with a broad forehead, dark determined eyes, thick brows, a short broad nose, a firm mouth and a smear of soot on the cheek. Hair: grey-black, in a topknot with the edge singed in an uneven line above the right ear. Body: broad, stout and braced, shoulders hunched to shield the plants. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of fine cloth with the sleeves tied back and the hem scorched by sparks, leather knee guards, and a straw cape; the robe is good cloth, only the fire has marked it. Hands and objects: both arms wrap a bundle of small grey-green seedlings with their root balls, held tight against his chest. Background: a dark field with a wall of orange fire in the soft distance. Light: orange firelight from the left, fading to old-silk yellow toward the edges. Qi: a faint pale green glimmer on the seedlings. Expression: a set jaw and eyes wet with smoke and something more, brave and stubborn, devoted to the plants more than to his own safety.

people.imagined: At dusk, lighting the grand elder's lamp, his thumb singed again. He glances at the cold furnace and quickly looks away.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at dusk lighting a small oil lamp, he looks up at the viewer with a quiet, loyal stare, his thumb tip singed black, having lit the grand elder's lamp every dusk for thirty-eight years and never once seen the old man look at the cold furnace. Face: a long, lean shepherd's face with windburnt tan skin, deep-set quiet brown eyes, plain brows, a long jaw, a closed gentle mouth and fine lines. Hair: dark brown, tied in a short topknot with a strip of cloth, a few white hairs showing at the temple. Body: tall, lean and patient, the shoulders narrow and slightly rounded and the big hands rough. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back, leather knee guards dark with years of use, a straw cape tied with a plain rope and a herb pouch at the hip. Hands and objects: the right thumb tip is dark and singed black, clearly shown, while the hand holds a lit taper to the wick of a small brass lamp. Background: a blurred dusk steppe and a cold bronze furnace in a dark corner. Light: warm lamp glow on his face and deep blue dusk behind. Qi: a faint gold-green shimmer. Expression: a quiet, gentle, reserved look, the eyes asking for nothing and the mouth closed, a loyalty long unspoken and never rewarded.

people.imagined: In the Furnace House, tasting a quarter dose from a thimble cup and speaking in a flat, unhurried voice, her gums stained grey-green.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a bench she lowers a thimble-sized cup from her lips, speaking calmly, showing grey-green stained gums. She has tasted a quarter dose, and now waits to see what it will do; her voice when she speaks is flat and unhurried. Face: a long, still, pale face; calm, heavy-lidded grey-brown eyes; straight level brows; a narrow nose; her lips parted slightly so that grey-green gums and teeth are plainly visible. Hair: black, in a smooth tight low bun. A single grey streak crosses the black of her temple. Body: tall, lean, still. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth, sleeves tied back by cords; a leather apron; a herb pouch. The robe's tied sleeves show thin arms stained faintly green to the wrist; the apron is stiff with dried drops. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a tiny white porcelain cup; the left hand rests on a bench with a small brass balance. The brass balance has tiny weights, each polished, and a spoon lies beside the cup. Background: blurred shelves of clay jars, an orange furnace glow. Shelves of clay jars are labelled with dabs of coloured clay, no writing. Light: warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green haze over the cup. Expression: flat, unhurried, composed. No flicker of pleasure or distaste crosses her face; the gums, grey-green, are the only sign of what she has swallowed.

people.imagined: Barefoot on the Dusk Field at day's end, heels cracked like dry paddy, glancing over her shoulder as if she has said something she should not have.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot in a field at dusk, she glances over her shoulder with a smile that has something behind it, her heels cracked like dry paddy; she has sold Ôn's name for a better row and the thought glints in her eyes before she hides it. Face: a round, tanned, lively face with bright dark eyes, thin arched brows, a wide mouth with an easy smile, small even teeth, faint freckles, broad brown cheeks and a smudge of mud on the chin. Hair: black, in a plait over one shoulder with a bit of straw stuck in it. Body: sturdy and light on her feet, a wide stance with the toes gripping the ground like a girl who has stood in paddies all her life. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back and the hem tucked up high, a straw cape hanging from one shoulder; her bare feet, with deep dry cracks across the heels, are clearly visible in the frame. Hands and objects: she holds a small bundle of picked herbs behind her back. Background: a blurred golden field, a rice-paddy bund and a low violet hill. Light: warm low light from the upper left, lighting the cracks of her heels. Qi: none. Expression: an easy, friendly grin that does not quite hold steady, the eyes sliding sideways for an instant, a practical girl pleased with a bargain she would rather not discuss.

people.imagined: Bent over a table grinding root, so intent he seems to be reading the wood's grain. The mortar dust whitens his brows; his smile is the calm kind.
people.subject: The moment: bent low over a table grinding a pestle in a stone mortar, he lifts only his eyes to the viewer with a calm smile that does not reach them. He weighs the head's antidote a grain heavy and the scale's pans settle; nobody else will notice, only the fits at night. Face: a long, pale, calm face; a narrow nose; thin lips smiling gently; cool dark eyes; eyebrows whitened with mortar dust, clearly visible. His face is long and calm with thin, even brows and a faint smile that never changes. Hair: black, in a neat topknot. A little white mortar dust is on his topknot. Body: tall and stooped, shoulders forward. His spine curves over the table like a heron's neck. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth, sleeves tied back; a herb pouch; a clean leather apron. The robe's sleeves are tied tight with clean linen cord, and the apron is spotless except for fine white dust at the hem. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a stone pestle in a mortar of pale grey root powder; a brass balance with tiny weights at his elbow. A small brass weight sits beside the pestle, one grain heavier than it should be. Background: blurred shelves with clay jars. Light: pale light from the upper left. Qi: a faint dull green haze. Expression: calm, courteous, cold. A calm, polite smile, and cold interest in the eyes.

people.imagined: Cutting mistletoe high in a mulberry tree, scalded fingertips shining. A letter is tucked unopened in her pouch.
people.subject: The moment: perched at a fork in a mulberry tree, she holds up a clump of mistletoe and a small curved knife and looks down at the viewer, on the day she will carry the letter to the Thúy Vi buyer and, as always, will not open it. Face: a round, friendly, rosy face with large trusting dark eyes, thin brows, a button nose and an open smile. Hair: black, in two short bunches tied with silk thread left over from her father's vats. Body: small, light and climbing, one foot braced on a branch and one knee up. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back, small new pale leather knee guards, a short neat straw cape, and a herb pouch with the corner of a sealed paper showing, no writing on it. Hands and objects: her fingertips are red, shiny and smooth like scalded skin, clearly visible; one hand holds the curved little knife, the other a green clump of mistletoe with white berries. Background: a green leaf canopy and soft sky. Light: pale green-gold leaf light from the upper left, speckled on her cheek. Qi: a faint pale green shimmer. Expression: a trusting, cheerful look, the smile open and the eyes clear, a girl with no idea what the letters hold and no wish to know.

people.imagined: Half a step in front of his sister in the field at dusk, a broad plain face, glancing back to ask her to stop humming.
people.subject: The moment: standing half a step forward, he glances back past his shoulder with a heavy-browed frown to quiet his sister, who has begun to hum the forbidden tune, then looks at the viewer; he is trying to hush her before the choir leader hears. Face: a broad, plain, heavy-browed face with a thick ridge of brow nearly meeting across the nose, deep-set small dark eyes, a wide flat nose, thick lips set in worry and dark skin. Hair: black, cropped short and rough, standing up stiffly where he has run a hand through it. Body: thick-set, strong and protective, one foot planted ahead of the other so that his body stands between the viewer and his sister. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the sleeves tied back, leather knee guards sewn on, and a straw cape. Hands and objects: one hand held out behind him, palm down, in a quieting gesture; the other holds a bundle of herbs. Background: a blurred golden field and a purple hill, with the edge of a girl's braid at the frame side. Light: warm low light from the upper left. Qi: a faint gold-green shimmer. Expression: worry puckering the heavy brow and the corners of the mouth pulled down, stubborn and protective, the look of a big brother bracing to take the blame.

people.imagined: At dawn at the furnaces, banking the founder's coals with a small shovel. She does not look away from them, even to speak.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at a furnace mouth at dawn with a small iron shovel, she turns her head sharply toward the viewer, eyes darting, as if someone had taken a step; the founder's coals must not go out and she has not slept in two days. Face: a hard, narrow, tanned face with sharp dark eyes in a suspicious stare, straight tight brows, a thin mouth held tight, and white lime dust on one cheek. Hair: black, in a tight bun with lime-white powder worked through it, clearly visible. Body: lean, wiry and tense, crouched like a spring with her weight on the balls of her feet. Clothing: a smoke-grey robe of good cloth with the left sleeve pushed up, a sturdy leather apron whose front is blackened with soot and scorched over the left hip, and leather knee guards. Hands and objects: her left forearm shows a ladder of eight short pale burn scars in a row, clearly visible; the right hand holds a small iron shovel full of red-orange coals. Background: a dark furnace room with a soft pale dawn at the door. Light: orange coal glow from below and the left. Qi: a faint warm red-orange shimmer. Expression: a bright, anxious, devout vigilance, the eyes wide and the lips pressed thin, a fear of failing the founder that has become a kind of worship.
